findings: Dispatch gating verified: patient dispatch is reachable only after an acquisition poll returns status COMPLETE with remote.status VALIDATED; non-COMPLETE polls and FAILED/NOT_VISIBLE/unknown states return before dispatch (covered by test_failure_and_unknown_state_never_dispatch and test_only_validated_acquisition_dispatches_once).

Immediate gate recheck verified: dispatch() re-runs approval() — review response binding, source-file SHA-256 bindings, and both adapter review checks (acquisition.reviewed, patient.require_patient_review) — immediately before the only patient mutation, closing the window between controller startup and a dispatch that may occur hours later.

Single mutation, no retries: patient.worker execution is invoked at most once; any result other than COMPLETE + DISPATCHED_NOT_YET_VALIDATED returns DISPATCH_BLOCKED with no retry (tested). All other adapter calls are read-only polls per the approved adapter contracts.
Fixed archive path: the execution packet uses the hardcoded literal '/content/isles-p001-input-16813698/train.7z'; no path is derived from remote output.

Serial and bounded: single-threaded sequential flow with distinct per-call attempt directories; each phase capped at 60 polls with 5-minute pauses (~5 h per phase); terminal statuses stop the controller, and patient VALIDATED yields NEEDS_PRIVATE_RETURN_TRANSFER so the private-return transfer remains an operator action. Observation duration does not extend the unchanged 4-hour acquisition or 60-minute patient analysis limits.

Rerun and receipt hygiene: private_dir exclusive destination makes reruns fail with FileExistsError (tested); the shared counter increments exactly once per adapter call so event-N.json receipts are distinct and ordered; outcome.json is written once.
Tests are fully synthetic: approval, time.sleep, and both adapters are patched; no network, tools, or patient data are touched.

Minor, non-blocking: main() exits 0 for all outcomes including blocked/stopped ones, so operators and harnesses must read outcome.json or stdout rather than the process exit code; an unhandled adapter exception fail-stops without writing outcome.json — safe (no mutation retry) but leaves no outcome receipt.

Scope condition: this review assessed composition only and takes as given the stated guarantees of the previously Fable-approved adapters (acquisition at bdf4369996364511e8bd824d4711907fa5fb71ea, patient at 465a0c3b1f2e8486a13e68dfd2179b3bfd16840d) — their own review/file bindings, exact cells/source readback, private console capture, fixed statuses, and the VALIDATED semantics described — plus the integrity of the harness-produced execution.json used by approval().
